title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: read-only access to device onboarding with View-Only Device Management
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned read-only role from the currently documented Entra-only device permissions. Two minor corrections remain: extend the role-group navigation to membership selection and reflect the published product-level licensing while retaining the narrower uncertainty about the planned role.

claims.quote:
| Feature | Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5, Microsoft Purview Suite/EDU/GOV/FLW and Microsoft Defender + Purview Suite FLW, Microsoft 365 E5/A5/F5/G5 Information Protection & Governance |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint Data Loss Prevention (DLP) | Included |
claims.fix: The role-specific gap is valid, but unknown understates published product-level licensing. Set licensing.model to 'included' and licensing.notes to 'Endpoint DLP is included in Microsoft 365 E5/A5/G5 and other plans listed in the Microsoft Purview service description. Users assigned a Purview role for the portal require a licence; a licence specific to this planned read-only access is not yet published.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/microsoft-365-service-descriptions/microsoft-365-tenantlevel-services-licensing-guidance/microsoft-purview-service-description.
